errors.evidence: The x-axis label in the figure is "Perturbation Strength σₐ", not σ_q.

errors.text_span: and a corresponding uncertainty metric on the y-axis
errors.evidence: The y-axis is not labeled in the figure. Describing it as an "uncertainty metric" is an interpretation not directly supported by the visual information provided.

The x-axis does not use a linear scale. The physical spacing between the tick marks is not proportional to the difference in their values (e.g., the gap between 0.2 and 0.5 is much larger than the gap between 0.15 and 0.2).
The TU (blue) line begins to visibly rise after σ_q = 0.1. Stating it stays constant until 0.2 is an oversimplification of the trend, as there is a noticeable upward slope between 0.1 and 0.2.
